Applications

Where Hitelecom devices
are deployed.

One hardware and connectivity system, configured around each environment.

01 Smart Cities

Structural health monitoring

Track tilt, vibration and changing conditions across bridges, towers, poles, façades and other distributed structures.

02 Smart Factories

Environment & equipment condition

Connect temperature, humidity, gas, pressure, vibration and status data across production areas and utilities.

03 Smart Warehousing

Storage conditions & rack safety

Environmental records, tilt events and structural awareness for warehouses, archives and high-bay racks.

04 Smart Water

Pipeline, level & blockage monitoring

Watch remote pipes, chambers, tanks and channels for water level, overflow and abnormal operating conditions.

05 Smart Heritage

Microclimate & artifact movement

Monitor temperature, humidity, light, vibration and movement across museums, historic sites and cultural collections.

06 Smart Transportation

Assets, structures & roadside safety

Combine location, motion, tilt and geofence events for mobile assets, signs, bridges and roadside equipment.

07 Cold Chain & Healthcare

Temperature records that travel

Reliable temperature and humidity monitoring for logistics, laboratories, pharmacies, cold rooms and storage.

08 Smart Sanitation

Bin fill-level & overflow monitoring

Use remote distance and status sensing to plan collection, detect overflow and reduce unnecessary service trips.
